method: Codex proposed 29 Spanish aliases grounded in course usage and rejected 146 candidates. Each proposal below was then decided explicitly. Two regex classifiers for 'name vs gloss' failed in opposite directions before this, so the call is made per item with a reason. The only harm that matters is over-breadth: a phrase that also names other things makes the concept map count false mentions and shows the wrong hover hint (the 'matching' incident). Being a gloss is not harmful in itself.
